title: Lineage-linked benchmark maintenance: Run G materials and lineage_requeue tool
description: Materials for a provisional, LLM-reviewed audit of MMLU-derived MMLU-Pro items: reconstructed item-level lineage (IDs, hashes, parent-child diffs), the 100-item three-arm experiment, the 50-item pilot, the lineage_requeue tool, the maintainer case ledger, archived re-review queues and per-correction regression checks. No defect label has been checked by a human expert. Complete third-party datasets are not included; rebuild instructions are provided.
